digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 24 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: github/spec-kit
repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
repos.summary_zh: 规范驱动开发起步工具箱，用声明式规格约束代码生成与演进，让团队从设计源头对齐实现

repos.name: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.summary_zh: 一键生成高清短视频的自动化工作流，输入主题即可完成从文案到成片全流程，零门槛上手

repos.name: earendil-works/pi
repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: 统一大模型 API 并内置 Agent 循环与 TUI 终端，让开发者快速构建可交互的编码智能体

repos.name: usestrix/strix
repos.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 AI 渗透测试工具，自动发现并修复应用漏洞，让安全测试像聊天一样简单

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: smicallef/spiderfoot
repos.description: SpiderFoot automates OSINT for threat intelligence and mapping your attack surface.
repos.summary_zh: 开源网络情报自动化工具，一键映射攻击面并持续追踪威胁线索，安全研究员的侦察利器

repos.name: RyanCodrai/turbovec
repos.description: A vector index built on TurboQuant, written in Rust with Python bindings
repos.summary_zh: 基于 TurboQuant 的 Rust 向量索引，Python 绑定加持，为 RAG 提供高性能检索底座

repos.name: eneskirca/nodeterm
repos.description: Node-based terminal manager for AI coding agents — tmux-backed terminals and parallel agent sessions as draggable nodes on an infinite pan/zoom canvas
repos.summary_zh: AI 编码代理的终端管理器，把 tmux 会话变成可拖拽节点，在无限画布上并行操控多个 Agent

repos.name: xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3
repos.description: Spectrum-based acceleration for ComfyUI’s native MiniMax H3 audio-video model. Forecasts post-transformer features with Chebyshev ridge regression to
repos.summary_zh: 用切比雪夫岭回归预测后变换特征，跳过部分Transformer计算，为ComfyUI的MiniMax H3音视频模型提速

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: jundot/omlx
repos.description: LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching for Apple Silicon — managed from the macOS menu bar
repos.summary_zh: Mac 菜单栏一键管理 LLM 推理服务，连续批处理加 SSD 缓存让 Apple Silicon 跑大模型又快又省

repos.name: semantica-agi/semantica
repos.description: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
repos.summary_zh: 图原生基础设施让 AI 上下文可追溯可审计，专为负责任智能体系统打造

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 2.78万亿参数模型单CPU跑进8.24GB内存，纯C99无依赖硬核推理

repos.name: NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard
repos.description: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling f
repos.summary_zh: 开源 LLM 网关，兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 协议，实现多模型路由、基准测试与成本优化

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: unslothai/unsloth
repos.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
repos.summary_zh: 本地化训练推理大模型与扩散模型的极速方案，支持最新架构并大幅降低显存占用

repos.name: Lightricks/LTX-2
repos.description: Official Python inference and LoRA trainer package for the LTX-2 audio–video generative model.
repos.summary_zh: LTX-2 官方推理与 LoRA 训练工具，让音频视频联合生成模型轻松微调，一站式搞定创意制作

repos.name: MakazhanAlpamys/Soup
repos.description: Fine-tune LLMs from one YAML. Layer streaming trains an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 一份 YAML 配置即可微调大模型，流式分层训练让 8B 模型跑在 4GB 显存笔记本上

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 专测多模态大模型原子级视觉感知的基准，能精准定位模型在细节识别上的短板

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: amruthpillai/reactive-resume
repos.description: A one-of-a-kind resume builder that keeps your privacy in mind. Completely secure, customizable, portable, open-source and free forever. Try it out to
repos.summary_zh: 隐私优先的开源简历生成器，模板丰富且支持云端同步，永久免费无追踪

repos.name: longbridge/gpui-component
repos.description: Rust GUI components for building fantastic cross-platform desktop application by using GPUI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面组件库，让开发者用原生性能快速构建精致界面

repos.name: bia-pain-bache/BPB-Worker-Panel
repos.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, cle
repos.summary_zh: 自建 Worker 订阅面板，聚合 VLESS、Trojan 与 Warp 节点，内置私有 DoH 和完整路由配置，一键解锁干净 IP 与碎片化代理

repos.name: fluxerapp/fluxer
repos.description: A free and open source instant messaging and VoIP chat app built for friends, groups, and communities.
repos.summary_zh: 开源即时通讯与 VoIP 聊天应用，为朋友和社群提供自由无广告的私密沟通体验

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: public-apis/public-apis
repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: 免费 API 大全集，开发者找接口不用再翻遍全网，按分类速查超方便

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 与 Tree-sitter 团队打造的 Rust 高性能多人协作编辑器，让编码快如闪电

repos.name: OpenCut-app/OpenCut
repos.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
repos.summary_zh: 开源版剪映替代品，用TypeScript打造，提供免费无限制的视频剪辑体验

repos.name: unionlabs/union
repos.description: The trust-minimized, zero-knowledge bridging protocol, designed for censorship resistance, extremely high security, and usage in decentralized finance
repos.summary_zh: 零知识跨链桥协议，抗审查且高安全，专为 DeFi 场景打造信任最小化传输

papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly require selective removal of harmful or sensitive knowledge, called unlearning, yet existing methods and benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability completel
papers.summary_zh: 提出概念敏感遗忘基准ConceptGuard，区分上下文相关与无关知识，测试显示现有方法在敏感场景下遗忘成功率不足50%

papers.title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation
papers.abstract: Heterogeneous AI systems composed of multiple models, architectures, harnesses, or inference-time settings can improve quality and efficiency by routing queries to the specialist who can answer most e

papers.title: Physical-Support Confidence Sets for Highly Coherent Dictionaries
papers.abstract: Sparse pursuit after dictionary learning can yield a precise atom support even when its physical interpretation is not justified by the calibration data, especially for highly coherent dictionaries wh

papers.title: $TCP_α$: Margin-Controlled Confidence estimation for reliable Music Information Retrieval
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks are often overconfident, assigning high confidence even to incorrect predictions. Consequently, users lack a reliable signal for deciding when a prediction can be trusted. Post-ho
papers.summary_zh: 提出边际控制置信估计法TCPα，在冻结分类器上训练轻量辅助头，有效抑制过自信并提升音乐信息检索可靠性

papers.title: Inducing Task Models from Computer-Use Traces
papers.abstract: Naturalistic computer-use traces, passively recorded screenshots and mouse or keyboard actions, are a valuable resource for deriving symbolic, auditable, and reusable models of how everyday work is do
papers.summary_zh: 提出从自然计算机使用轨迹中归纳符号化任务模型的方法，以被动录屏与键鼠操作生成可审计复用流程，无需人工标注即可自动构建任务结构

papers.title: Projecting BrowseComp-Plus onto ClimbMix: Toward More Realistic Corpora for Agentic Search
papers.abstract: The BrowseComp-Plus benchmark disentangled the evaluation of agentic search by replacing opaque web search with a fixed corpus, so that an agent's role can be separated from the retriever's. That corp
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于固定语料库的智能体搜索评测框架，将检索器与智能体解耦，并构建百万级文档集以提升真实性与可扩展性

papers.title: An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction
papers.abstract: Travel behavior research increasingly combines digital data collection with predictive modeling, yet these stages are often developed and evaluated separately. This study proposes a three-agent workfl

papers.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) asks whether an AI system can improve the process that produces AI systems, so that the next system inherits the improvement. That process is the training algorithm: a

papers.title: MidTool: Mid-training Data Synthesis for Agentic Tool Use
papers.abstract: Mid-training is increasingly recognized as a critical stage for shaping the capabilities of large language models. Recent work has shown that targeted mid-training can strengthen reasoning-intensive a

papers.title: G-CARL: Grounded Checklist-Aligned Reward Learning for Patient-Oriented Medical Report Interpretation
papers.abstract: Personalized interpretation of medical reports has emerged as an increasingly important need among patients. Addressing this need requires both evidence-grounded medical factuality and context-depende

papers.title: Information on trajectories: martingales and random times
papers.abstract: Accounting for information flow on the path space of trajectories of a nonnegative martingale yields exact variational identities for it, even at arbitrary random times. This recovers the widely used
papers.summary_zh: 提出轨迹空间信息流变分恒等式，统一恢复Ville至PAC-Bayes经典集中不等式，并量化各不等式丢弃的信息量，适用于任意随机时刻

papers.title: A comparison between ceiling-mounted FMCW, IR-UWB and Wi-Fi radar for in-bedroom human activity monitoring and sleep interruption detection
papers.abstract: Despite their growing importance for contact-free radio frequency (RF) based healthcare monitoring, different radio technologies such as frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar, impulse radio
papers.summary_zh: 首次同场景对比三种射频雷达监测卧室人体活动，FMCW在睡眠中断检测中准确率最高达95%，Wi-Fi成本最低但精度略逊

papers.title: Explainable Transformer Models for Clinical Prediction Tasks on Structured Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract: Predictive models over structured electronic health records (EHRs) remain central to machine learning for healthcare, but few have jointly emphasized quantitative laboratory information and interpreta
papers.summary_zh: 提出BERT-LER模型融合定量检验值与事件编码，在结构化EHR预测中实现可解释注意力，性能较基线提升显著且临床事件归因更透明
